brief:
Israeli forces conducted a raid on the Bethlehem Arab Society for Rehabilitation Hospital on Monday, Middle East Eye reported. The operation sparked panic among patients and visitors present at the facility. Personnel and individuals at the hospital were physically assaulted during the incursion.

The raid's stated objective and the duration of the operation were not disclosed in available accounts. The hospital, located in the occupied West Bank city of Bethlehem, provides rehabilitation services to patients in the area.
